dedupe_keys.name: aggregated stitched and de drifted cmip climate data

description: This Zenodo deposit contains compact regional aggregates of CMIP5 and CMIP6 climate-model experiments processed with netCDF-SCM. It provides monthly and annual global, hemispheric and land/ocean means, with experiment segments stitched together and model drift removed. Text-based tables distributed in archives are free under CC-BY-4.0. The data can calibrate reduced-complexity climate models and connect climate scenario assumptions to long-term infrastructure adaptation simulations. They complement full gridded CMIP output by reducing the volume and processing required for aggregate comparisons. Source metadata are retained to support provenance and checks for retracted model output. Coverage differs by experiment and model; an archive release does not imply that every later CMIP submission is included. These spatial averages cannot supply local flood, wind or urban-heat extremes. The article’s accompanying website was blocked by its security service during review, but the independently accessible Zenodo repository established the dataset identity, terms and downloadable products.
